summary: Sets out requirements for the protocol between path computation clients and path computation elements, and for discovering them, when traffic engineering spans several network layers such as MPLS and GMPLS layers. Planning end to end across layers can make the whole network more efficient. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A trip may use a train, then a bus. Planning it together beats planning each alone. This lists what network route planners need to plan across layers.
